sharing: One Read and one independently parameterized Write, shared across all16 sublayers. Backbone blocks are independent.
state_scope: Per token, across depth only; reset on every forward. No cross-token state attention; backbone is causal.

initialization.slots: Embedding + learned centered tetrahedral offsets with unit RMS per head
initialization.write: V/O identity,Q/K scaled identity targeting logit margin6 between distinct slots
initialization.limitations: Approximate initial self retention, not exact identity or a guarantee against later collapse. The new-output key initially receives small nonzero mass. No diagonal mask/bias or residual bypass.

normalization: Original embedding RMSNorm, branch pre-RMSNorm, backbone QK norm and final RMSNorm remain. No new state/query norm.
optimizer: Backbone unchanged;9 shared connector tensors use existing connector AdamW at unembedding LR, zero decay
backend: Existing FA3 on Hopper; explicitly noncausal SDPA/FA2 for slot attention on A100. No causal masking along the slot axis. FP32 oracle/debug alternative.

validation.cpu: FP64 outputs/all VJPs; state replacement/locality/sharing;16-step initial signal and gradient retention
validation.gpu: 2K causality;KV-cache;CCE;compile/recompute;optimizer checkpoint;60-step same-card profiles;25->50 real process resume
